name: ultraton-compat
description: Integration tests of the published ultraton package with real third-party clients. Never part of the ultraton tarball. Install the packed tarball first, from the repository root: rm -f compat/ultraton-*.tgz && npm pack --pack-destination compat, then in compat/: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts ./ultraton-*.tgz
